generations.prompt: Midday in a crowded village market square of timber-framed houses and canvas-roofed stalls. A bareheaded medieval jongleur in a ragged red-and-blue parti-coloured tunic completes a backflip over the cobbles between the stalls, lands on his feet, throws his arms wide for applause that never comes, then turns a fast cartwheel and springs into a second backflip; around him nobody looks: two merchants keep haggling over cloth with their backs to him, a woman picks through turnips, a man on a cart keeps eating, a mother pulls her child away; the scruffy dog watches him. Camera level, nearly static. Photoreal, cinematic film look, 35mm, shallow depth of field, film grain. No text, no captions.
